browser_reporting_collector.py:51 — validate_timestamp/validate_age use truthiness checks, so age: 0 alongside timestamp bypasses the mutual-exclusion check. Use 'in' / 'is not None' checks.
records.rationale: In `BrowserReportSerializer` (browser_reporting_collector.py), `validate_timestamp` uses `if self.initial_data.get("age"):` and `validate_age` uses `if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"):`. These are truthiness checks, so `age: 0` (or `timestamp: 0`) will not trigger the mutual-exclusion validation even though both fields are present, allowing invalid mixed-spec payloads to pass validation.
